scripts.format: oxfmt src e2e scripts vite.config.ts playwright.config.ts && prettier --write "*.{css,html}" "partials/*.html"
scripts.format:check: oxfmt --check src e2e scripts vite.config.ts playwright.config.ts && prettier --check "*.{css,html}" "partials/*.html"
scripts.lint: oxlint src e2e scripts vite.config.ts playwright.config.ts && npm run lint:css
scripts.lint:fix: oxlint --fix src e2e scripts vite.config.ts playwright.config.ts && npm run lint:css:fix
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && tsc --noEmit && vitest run
scripts.check:all: npm run check && npm run test:e2e && npm run build
